projects.name: Synconomics ERP
projects.desc: An advanced enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform designed to streamline business automation for SMEs, featuring AI workflow integrations.
details: Architected and managed the core backend infrastructure.
Integrated Gemini API (3.1) services to drive intelligent business workflow automations.
Containerized application stacks utilizing Docker and implemented Redis caching layers.
Established real-time infrastructure telemetry using Beszel monitoring.

projects.name: OSIS Online Voting System
projects.desc: A highly secure digital voting platform for student council elections with strict validation and server hardening.
details: Developed a secure voting platform leveraging strict server-side validation and cryptographic integrity.
Hardened local production server environments, supporting over 1,000 concurrent users with zero downtime.

projects.name: Enterprise Infrastructure Virtualization
projects.desc: On-premise physical enterprise server clustering and virtualization using Proxmox VE and hardware management.
details: Managed physical Dell PowerEdge rack servers directly.
Configured Proxmox VE hypervisors for advanced resource virtualization.
Optimized reverse proxies using Nginx and Caddy to secure SSL/TLS routing.

projects.name: SyncQL
projects.desc: An online SQL editor built by SynchronizesTeams, featuring a collaborative web-based interface for writing and executing SQL queries in the browser.
details: Contributed to SyncQL, an online SQL editor under the SynchronizesTeams organization.
Built with Nuxt.js and Vue 3 with full TypeScript support for a modern development experience.
Deployed at syncql.synchronizeteams.com with a production-ready Nuxt build pipeline.
Managed frontend state and API integration for real-time SQL query execution.

projects.name: API-Hug
projects.desc: A lightweight Go CLI tool for stress testing and comparing API performance between two environments (e.g., Local vs. Production). Sends concurrent requests and generates detailed reports.
details: Built a concurrent load testing tool using goroutines to send HTTP requests simultaneously.
Implemented side-by-side environment comparison (Local vs. Server) with comprehensive metrics.
Added JSON and styled HTML export functionality for automated reporting and dashboards.
Recorded metrics including Total Requests, Success/Failure Rates, and Min/Max/Avg Response Times.

projects.name: GoCard
projects.desc: A professional, high-performance Go CLI tool that generates stunning Neo-Brutalism style HTML repository cards for GitHub projects, complete with README previews and dev icons.
details: Built a CLI tool using Go and Cobra to generate Neo-Brutalism styled repository cards.
Integrated the GitHub API to dynamically fetch repository data and README content.
Implemented server-side HTML rendering with Lucide Icons and Devicon for visual polish.
Supported optional PNG export via headless Chrome and custom output filename flags.

projects.name: portoadeli
projects.desc: Personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, and contact information. Built with vanilla HTML and TailwindCSS, deployed at adeli.tech.
details: Designed and built a personal portfolio site using HTML and TailwindCSS from scratch.
Deployed on Vercel with a custom domain at adeli.tech.
Structured with modular pages directory and static asset management.
Configured custom .htaccess rules and 404 error handling for clean URL routing.
